semiconductor_relevance: Low — Cir-Q-Tech Tako Technologies Pvt. Ltd. primarily focuses on Electro Static Discharge (ESD) control products and services rather than semiconductor manufacturing or design.
summary: Cir-Q-Tech Tako Technologies Pvt Ltd specializes in providing comprehensive ESD control solutions, including products and services designed to prevent ESD damage in various industries. Their offerings include ESD flooring, workstations, and ionization equipment, which are crucial for maintaining product integrity in sensitive environments.

regional_presence.India: The company has offices in major cities including Bangalore, Chennai, New Delhi, Hyderabad, and Pune, providing extensive support across the country.
